messages:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — gpu-pool-prod queue length spike > 95th percentile, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (scale requests queuing). Generation latency elevated, some 504s. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-autoscale. Paging infra-oncall. :pager:
ryan: ack — I'm oncall, checking autoscaler + node health now.
maya: seeing repeated CUDA/Xid and OOM logs on gnode-12 and gnode-15. Looks like driver faults causing effective GPU capacity loss.
ben: @maya can you paste the dmesg / Xid snippet? Might be the driver bits we rolled last night.
ryan: pasted dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1343.124567] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 13, pid=12345, GPU a0: PTX warp exception
[ 1343.124570] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 9876 (python) total-vm:24G anon-rss:18G
```
Also autoscaler logs show: `scale-up request queued -> cloud: InsufficientCapacity` repeatedly.
claire: suggestion — temporarily lower concurrency on heavy-model routes and bump autoscaler min_replicas +2 to give buffer while we mitigate.
ryan: running quick mitigations: 1) patch routes: set max_concurrency=1 for /v1/embeddings 2) set autoscaler.min_replicas= current+2 for gpu-pool-prod
```
# k8s commands
kubectl -n inference patch hpa gpu-pool-prod-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'
kubectl -n inference annotate route embeddings traffic-routing=dedicated-temp
```
maya: good. I'm going to cordon gnode-12 and gnode-15 and drain to offload their workloads. If driver restart required we'll reboot those nodes.
ryan: cordoned/drained gnode-12. Drain command used: `kubectl drain gnode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
ops-bot: cloud: scale-group create request for g5 instances returned InsufficientCapacity in us-west-2 (attempts: 3). Autoscaler queued 4 pending scale-ups.
ben: deploying a targeted driver rollback to 2 nodes (canary) — if it clears Xid we'll roll further. ETA 8m.
customer-success-jen: FYI we've got 3 paying customers reporting timeouts on embeddings/generate; visible 95th latency > 10s for them. CS alerted.
ryan: rerouted embeddings traffic to gpu-dedicated-1 (lower capacity but healthy). Observability: queued requests dropped ~40% after reroute. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: metrics update: queue_length(gpu-pool-prod)= -42% in 5m, 504_count down 60% on embeddings route.
maya: can confirm Xid events stopped on the remaining nodes after driver canary applied to gnode-20/gnode-21. Looks like driver regression triggered by recent kernel module.
ben: continuing roll of driver rollback to affected pools. Will coordinate with infra to avoid mass reboots.
ryan: customer impact summary: degraded latency and timeouts for a subset of users on embeddings/generate endpoints for ~18m window. No data loss. Affected customers notified by CS.
claire: ops request to cloud team: ask for temporary capacity quota bump for g5 in us-west-2 to allow autoscaler to recover when we re-open traffic.
ops-bot: cloud ticket created #CLOUD-4873 (quota/availability request).
ryan: prepping handoff — I'll hand to night oncall @alex in 20m. TODOs for handoff: 1) continue driver roll until all Xid stops 2) keep embeddings traffic on dedicated-temp until steady 3) verify autoscaler scale-ups succeed once quota confirmed 4) post-incident postmortem + revert gating for last driver roll.
alex: (ack via mention) I'll pick this up. Add me to the cloud ticket and leave links to the nodes and runbook.
ben: will follow up in the postmortem with driver regression trace and build ID.
customer-success-jen: customers updated, CS tracking ongoing.
ryan: closing active pager for now — systems trending stable, but handoff live. Postmortem owners: ben (driver), maya (runtime), claire (scaling), ryan (incident lead).
incident-bot: Runbook reminder: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-autoscale — attach logs and timeline within 24h. :memo:
